findings.text: Public diagnostic entry prints processor register state for a fault context, selecting a restricted view for user mode and a fuller view otherwise, and additionally emits a call trace when the fault occurred inside the kernel.

Thirty two bit helper maps internal stack category enumeration to short human readable tag for trace delimiters, covering interrupt, soft interrupt, entry trampoline and double fault categories, returning no tag for other values.

Sixty four bit helper maps stack category to diagnostic tag, covering task, interrupt, soft interrupt and entry trampoline plus a range of hardware exception stacks resolved through a name table, with compile time check on table size.

Thirty two bit classifier resolves a stack address to a descriptor holding category, bounds and link onward, handling task stack for any task and entry plus interrupt plus soft interrupt plus double fault only for current context, rejecting unknown addresses.

Sixty four bit classifier resolves a stack address to a descriptor with recursion protection, delegating range tests to a non instrumented helper and then applying a visited category mask before reporting success.
Non instrumented sixty four bit classifier tests task stack first for any task, then exception, interrupt and entry ranges only when examining current task, reporting failure otherwise.
Task stack range predicate determines whether an address lies within the thread stack allocation for a given task, filling descriptor category, limits and null link on success.
Entry stack range predicate determines whether an address lies within the current processor entry stack allocation, filling descriptor category, limits and null link on success.

Unwinder accessor returns the storage location of the pending return address, using register instruction pointer slot when register state is present and frame pointer successor slot otherwise, or null when finished.

Unwinder iterator advances frame state toward the oldest caller, returning success while further frames remain and failure with terminal state once user boundary, last frame or unrecoverable address is reached.

Fault termination helper displays registers and loaded modules, then offers the event to the die notification chain as an oops with trap number from current thread and segmentation fault signal, interpreting a stop response as handled.
Trace wrapper suspends kernel address sanitizer around cross task stack examination and restores it afterwards, leaving sanitizer untouched when examining current task.

Call trace printer emits a header, initializes unwinder state, derives missing stack pointer from task and registers, aligns each stack link, validates it, retries with page alignment on invalid stacks, and walks onward through linked stacks until exhaustion.

Stack scanning considers only kernel text addresses, suppresses duplicate display of already shown instruction pointer, marks addresses matching the unwinder return slot as reliable and others as hints, and expands function graph trampolines to show both wrapper and underlying callee.

Register display on a stack is ordered by containment: full register block is shown only when entirely within current stack, partial interrupt frames only when their return frame lies within current stack, otherwise deferred to a later stack iteration.

Thirty two bit interrupt and soft interrupt stack checks accept the exclusive top as valid to represent empty software stacks, with onward link recovered from the base cell; double fault stack bounds come from per processor entry area and onward link from task state segment.

Sixty four bit exception stack membership is decided by address range, page index and descriptor size, rejecting guard pages, with category and bounds from descriptor and onward link from saved stack field in trailing register block.

Sixty four bit interrupt stack top pointer is adjusted before limit calculation, end is exclusive because final restore leaves the pointer off the stack, and onward link is taken from the reserved top cell.
Visited category mask prevents loops: each successful classification sets its category bit and a repeat classification warns once and is treated as unknown type and stops that chain.
Stack address logger touches the non maskable interrupt watchdog before emitting each address with reliability prefix and symbolic decoding at the supplied log level.

Unwinder suppresses warnings for expected failures: remote task races, interrupts inside entry text after an interrupt frame, register stack pointers near thread top, thirty two bit builds, and repeated remote failures all end silently.

Last task frame detection combines three patterns: exact terminal frame pointer, compiler realigned terminal frame with duplicated return slot, and function tracer prologue pattern with matching frame and return relationships.
Frame update enforces upward only progress within one stack category by comparing candidate frame against previous frame end when original pointer is known, rejecting overlapping or downward moves.

Frame update follows onward stack links until the candidate frame is contained, allowing traversal across empty intermediate stacks, and records interrupt arrival when the frame pointer decodes to register state.

Stack descriptor observed with four logical members: category enumeration, lower bound pointer, upper bound pointer, and onward stack pointer link that is null for task and entry stacks and populated for interrupt related stacks.

Unwinder state observed with task reference, optional register block, frame pointer, cached next frame pointer, decoded instruction address, original stack pointer, current stack descriptor, visited mask, graph index, interrupt flag and error flag.

Register block usage observed includes instruction pointer, frame pointer and stack pointer fields, with instruction pointer used for return slot and duplicate suppression and stack pointer used for exception link and terminal range checks.

Trace emission proceeds through header, unwinder initialization, per stack open tag, conditional register display, linear address scan with interleaved unwinder stepping and register refresh, per stack close tag, then advance to next linked stack.

Unwind iteration starts from done check, then user mode termination, then last frame handling that either ends for kernel threads or installs system call registers, then next pointer selection from cache or registers or stack memory, then stack state update with success continuation or error termination.

Stack state transition computes prior frame end, decodes register encoded pointers versus plain frames, switches stacks via onward links until containment, validates monotonicity, installs new register or frame state, recovers return address with user mode zeroing, and captures original pointer on first success.
Register show routine serves as the public fault diagnostic entry, invoked before module listing and die notification, and internally fans out to info line, register dump and conditional trace.

Stack classifier serves as the diagnostic stack identification entry, called for initial pointer validation, overflow retry, unwinder stack switching and debug dumping, returning zero on known stacks and negative invalid on unknown.
Unwind next frame serves as the iterative unwinding entry used during trace scanning, driving return slot reliability decisions and register refresh on each successful step.

Examining a task other than current races with concurrent execution and may observe changing stack contents, so failures in that case are treated as benign without warning and sanitizer is suspended to avoid false reports.
Stack overflow into an adjacent guard page yields an initially invalid classification; implementation retries with page aligned address to still produce partial diagnostic output before giving up.
Corrupt onward links or repeated stack categories could cause infinite trace loops; visited mask detection converts repeats to unknown type and stops further traversal of that chain.
Interrupts arriving in entry assembly before frame pointers are established can confuse the unwinder; such cases are recognized by interrupt history plus entry address range and terminated quietly.
Bad frame pointer values trigger a one time deferred warning with task identity and a full aligned stack dump that collapses zero runs and decodes symbols, after which further dumps are suppressed.
Unreliable scanned addresses are only hints and must not be treated as proven call sites; only slots confirmed by the unwinder return pointer are considered reliable.
Sixty four bit build asserts six hardware exception stacks and indexes exception names by category offset within an inclusive exception range.
Diagnostic tags observed are TASK, IRQ, SOFTIRQ, ENTRY_TRAMPOLINE and hash DF for double fault on thirty two bit, plus table driven exception names on sixty four bit.

Thirty two bit interrupt stacks derive bounds from per processor stack pointers plus thread size extent, while sixty four bit interrupt stack uses dedicated interrupt stack size and sixty four bit exception stacks use page shifted indexing.
Terminal frame calculations use thread register block minus two words for last frame, minus compiler realignment words for aligned variant, and minus three words for tracer variant.

Two frame pointer encodings are observed: one marks register blocks by low bit set with address recovered by clearing that bit and even values meaning plain frames, the other marks plain frames by top bit set with register blocks recovered by setting that bit.
Partial register display relies on interrupt return frame offset and size to validate and show only the return frame when full state was not yet saved.
